Empty Library guidance sends you back to the Connect screen

cards.title: Full-Screen Slide Viewer

Use Left and Right to move between slides
Use Back to return to the Library without losing the active session
The viewer keeps your current slide visible during brief loading or connection moments

cards.title: Slide Controls
bullets: Zoom in, zoom out, and reset zoom from the presentation options menu
Pan around zoomed slides with the Roku remote D-pad
Rotate slides when a different orientation is easier to view
Restart a presentation from the first slide when needed

cards.title: Search and Go To Slide
bullets: Search inside supported presentation text
Review matching slide numbers and snippets
Jump from a search result directly to the matching slide
Use Go to Slide with a TV-friendly numeric keypad

cards.title: Slide Thumbnails
bullets: Open a full-screen slide thumbnail navigator
Browse nearby slides with a focused center slide
Select a thumbnail to jump directly to that slide
Cancel thumbnail navigation without changing slides

bullets: Use Night Mode for easier viewing in a dark room
Save per-presentation viewing state during the current session
Restore slide position, zoom, rotation, pan, Night Mode, and Animation Mode when returning to a presentation
Open new presentations with sensible default viewing settings

bullets: Choose simple static viewing for predictable slide display
Step through supported presentation effects when available
Switch modes from the presentation options menu
Compatibility can vary by file, presentation content, and Roku device resources

cards.title: Subscription Support
bullets: Subscribe or manage your subscription from the app menu
Subscription purchase and recovery flows use the Roku channel store
Free users may be limited to the first configured number of slides per presentation
Subscribed users can continue viewing later slides without the free limit prompt

cards.title: Settings and Storage Tools
bullets: View TV screen resolution and screen ratio
Check temporary viewing file count and storage usage
Clear temporary storage when needed
See clear success, no-data, and failure messages for cleanup actions

cards.title: Help, Legal, and Support
bullets: Built-in Help/FAQ page with expandable questions
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use pages
About page with app, developer, and version details
Support and feedback page with QR codes for useful links

cards.title: Local Viewing Design
bullets: PPTX files are selected from your own phone, tablet, or computer
No cloud presentation storage account is required for viewing
Roku is not designed to permanently store your original PPTX files
Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings

cards.title: Localization Ready
bullets: Roku interface text uses localized app strings
Viewer controls, slide prompts, settings, and subscription messages support translation
The browser selection page includes localized status and error messages
Browser language selection can be stored locally on that browser

items.q: What is TV PPTX Viewer?
items.a: TV PPTX Viewer is a Roku app for viewing PowerPoint presentations on your TV with a remote-friendly interface.

items.q: How do I open PPTX files on my Roku TV?
items.a: Open the Connect screen, scan the QR code or enter the short address from a phone, tablet, or computer on the same Wi-Fi network, then choose the PPTX files you want to view.

items.q: Which presentation format is supported?
items.a: The app is designed for PPTX presentation files.

items.q: Can I choose more than one PPTX file?
items.a: Yes. You can select multiple PPTX files, and folder selection may also be available on supported devices and browsers.

items.q: Do my device and Roku need to be on the same Wi-Fi network?
items.a: Yes. The phone, tablet, or computer used to choose PPTX files should be connected to the same local Wi-Fi network as your Roku device.

items.q: Can I search inside a presentation?
items.a: Yes. The viewer includes search with results that can jump to matching slides when supported by the presentation.

items.q: Can I zoom, rotate, or pan slides?
items.a: Yes. The presentation options menu includes zoom, reset zoom, rotate, and pan support for zoomed slides.

items.q: Can I jump to a specific slide?
items.a: Yes. Use Go to Slide from the presentation options menu and enter a slide number with the TV-friendly keypad.

items.q: Does the app remember where I stopped?
items.a: While you are using the app, the viewer can restore per-presentation state such as slide position, zoom, rotation, pan, Night Mode, and Animation Mode.

items.q: Does Roku store my original PPTX files?
items.a: No. TV PPTX Viewer is designed for local viewing and is not designed to permanently store original PPTX files on Roku. Temporary viewing data can be cleared from Settings.

items.q: Where can I manage subscription information?
items.a: The app includes Subscribe and Manage Subscription options. Subscription purchase and recovery use the Roku channel store flow.
